correctness.rationale: Independently generated the 14-vertex Fano incidence graph (21 edges), exhaustively tested all 2^14 induced-vertex masks via components/Euler criterion, yielding 12792 faces including empty and exact ten-entry f-vector. Independently reproduced deterministic pivot matching (6392 pairs, 8 critical 9-vertex faces); full 81648 directed Hasse arcs topologically sorted with no cycle. Removing augmented empty pair leaves a vertex plus 8 cells of dimension 8, hence an integral wedge of eight S8 by discrete Morse. Independently enumerated 168 GL3(F2) actions, computed signed Lefschetz traces of all invariant faces and verified each equals #fixed building edges - #fixed building vertices +1. Character distribution 8:1,1:48,-1:56,0:63 and sum squared 168 prove irreducible Steinberg rational representation. All finite checks exhaust full finite object; no general projective-plane theorem.
